doc.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Music in the family home and church
summary: His mother played piano by ear and in church, his father sang tenor; popular songs of the day.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Now, were you parents, was there music in your home?

Well, there was the music of my mother, who played piano by ear, and my father had a beautiful tenor voice. And he would sing with his friends, like in the barber shop, quartet style. I remember that music in my home.
Were they popular tunes of the day, or...?
Yes, tunes of the day, like...Down By The Old Mill Stream, or...
...I remember my father used to sing that...Memories of You.
And uh did your mother play primarily in the home, or...?
Well, she played piano in the church, and for the choir. And she also sang in the choir from time to time.
So, did you hear...you heard music at home and in the church?
